content: Machanupagi mapanna Tengban Mapuna wa ngangbiba
Mamangeidadi Tengban Mapuna eikhoigi ipa ipusingda tongan tonganba mawongda Ibungo mahakki wa phongdokpa maichousinggi mapanna toina wa ngangbirammi,

adubu aroiba numitsing asidadi Ibungo mahakna mahakki Machanupagi mapanna eikhoida wa ngangbire. Ibungo mahakki mapanna Tengban Mapuna taibangpan pumba sembi aduga aroibada Tengban Mapuna Ibungo mahakpu pot pumnamakki mapu oinanaba khandokpire.

Machanupa asi Tengban Mapugi matik mangalgi arangba aduni amadi Tengban Mapu mahakmakki chap chaba saktamni, Ibungo mahakki panggalaba waheina pot pumnamakpu kaidana thambiri. Mioiba pumnamakki pap kokpinanaba thoudang pangthoklaba matungda Khwaidagi Panggallaba Tengban Mapu mahakki yetthangbada phamle.
Tengban Mapuna Machanupa aduda pibiba ming aduna swargadutsinggi mingdagi henna chaobagum, Machanupa adubu swargadutsingdagi henna chaohalle.
Maramdi Tengban Mapuna keidoungeidasu mahakki swargadutsingda masi khak haikhide,

content.text: ngasi eihak nahakki Napa Ibungo oire.”

content: Tengban Mapuna mahakki kanagumba swargadut amatagi maramda asumnasu haikhide,
Aduga Tengban Mapuna mahakki ahanba pokpa Machanupa adu taibangpanda tharamdaida, Ibungo mahakna hairak-i,
Aduga swargadutsinggi maramda Tengban mapuna hai,

content.text: aduga mahakki manaisingbu meigi meiri oihalli.”

content: Adubu Machanupa adugi maramda Tengban Mapuna hairak-i,

content.text: “He Tengban Mapu, nahakki leibakti loiba naidana matam pumnamakki oina leigani!
misinggi mathakta achumba wayen-ga loinana pan-gani.
Nahakna achumbabu nungsi aduga aranbabu tukkachei.
Maram aduna Tengban Mapu, nahakki Tengban Mapuna, nahakpu khanbire
aduga nahakki marup mapangsingdagi yamna henna ikaikhumnabagi nungaiba adu nangonda pibire.”
“MAPU IBUNGO, nahakna ahoubada malem asi sembibani,
aduga nongmadon atiya asi Ibungo nahakmakki khutna sembibani.
Makhoidi mangkhigani adubu Ibungo nahakti lengdana leigani;
aduga nahakki hingbadi aroiba haibadu leite.”

content: Tengban Mapuna keidoungeidasu mahakki kanagumba swargadut amatada asumna khak haikhide,
Adunadi swargadutsing asi karino? Makhoising asi Tengban Mapubu thougal touba amadi aran-khubham phanggadaba makhoisingbu mateng pangnaba Tengban Mapuna thabirakpa thawaisingni.
